questions.prompt: After a crash, call_2 has a tool/call event but no tool/result. What should the made-up result tell the model?
options: That the tool succeeded, so the model can continue
That the outcome is unknown, so it should check before retrying
That the tool never started, so it can retry at once
Nothing; the result should be empty
questions.explanation: The tool/call was flushed before the tool ran, so the tool may have changed something. The model must check before it repeats a write.

questions.prompt: Why must the missing results be appended before the step/end closer?
options: Because sequence numbers must go down
Because the provider refuses a tool call whose result does not come right after it
Because the model reads only the last event
questions.explanation: The provider needs every tool call answered in the next user message. Writing the results inside the step keeps each call next to its answer.

questions.prompt: What would be lost if mini-dsh did not flush before running a tool?
options: The tool results would not reach the model
The program could not tell a call that started from one that never started
The closers would get the wrong sequence numbers
The header line would be missing
questions.explanation: The tool/call on disk is the proof that the tool may have run. Without the flush, a started call could look the same as one that never began.
